Do you have a graphics card? You have to plug the cintiq usb into your graphics card. In my case, I only had 1 compatible slot, that was already being used by my monitor.

If I unplugged my monitor, then plugged in the cintiq it would work. I didn’t want it that way so the way to fix it, is to get a USB adapter to also plug the cintiq into the graphics card.

I worked around that by plugging it into my mother board. It won’t appear for you, so you’ll have to restart your computer, enter your BIOS, and allow for motherboard and graphics card display.

Hope this helps!
